hero.title: Mechanical Engineering Masters in Switzerland for Indian Students
hero.subtitle: A Master's in Mechanical Engineering in Switzerland for Indian Students offers Indian students a chance to acquire state-of-the-art skills in machine design, robotics, thermodynamics, materials science, manufacturing, automation, energy systems and computational engineering. Swiss universities are known for their research in engineering, technical innovation and strong ties with industry.

overview: A Master's in Mechanical Engineering in Switzerland for Indian Students offers Indian students a chance to acquire state-of-the-art skills in machine design, robotics, thermodynamics, materials science, manufacturing, automation, energy systems and computational engineering. Explore world-leading Swiss cantonal universities and federal institutes of technology offering globally renowned degrees, modern research labs, and international faculty.

universities.name: ETH Zurich (Swiss Federal Institute of Technology)
universities.desc: ETH Zurich ranks among the top universities worldwide for technology and natural sciences, producing 22 Nobel laureates including Albert Einstein.

universities.name: EPFL (École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne)
universities.desc: EPFL is a dynamic European research institute celebrated for computer science, robotics, biomedical innovation, and global startup spin-offs.

universities.name: University of Zurich (UZH)
universities.desc: The largest university in Switzerland, renowned for medical research, life sciences, banking and finance, and law.

universities.name: University of Geneva
universities.desc: Located near UN and WHO headquarters, world-famous for international relations, biomedical sciences, and multilateral diplomacy.
